# Results — Study 806 (Prospect-Theory Value)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test —
Barberis, Mukherjee & Wang (2016): a stock's **cumulative-prospect-theory (TK) value**
computed on its recent return distribution predicts its future return **negatively**, so a
long-low-TK / short-high-TK book should earn a positive spread. Offline & deterministic once
cached; run `python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every number. As-of **2026-06-30** (the
last complete calendar month; the partial current month is dropped). Fingerprint `5384b8f7f128`
(panel Close).*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Real tape | yfinance daily OHLC (`auto_adjust=True`, total-return), **50 liquid US large-caps**, 2010-01-04 → 2026-06-30, **4,147** dated rows/name |
| Universe | a fixed `UNIVERSE` of ~50 mega-caps, pulled through the **`quantlab.universe` survivorship guard** (`download_panel(..., allow_survivorship_bias=True)`), cached under this study's own `_cache/` |
| Signal | each name's **cumulative-prospect-theory (TK) value** of its **trailing 1,260-day (≈5y) daily-return distribution** — Tversky-Kahneman `v(x)=x^0.88`/`-2.25(-x)^0.88` with inverse-S probability weighting `w+ (γ=0.61)` / `w- (δ=0.69)`; decision weights = tail-cumulated weighted-probability differences. Known at the close of month `t` |
| Sort | each month rank the cross-section by the TK value; **long the bottom 30%** (low TK), **short the top 30%** (high TK), equal-weight; hold the **next** month. A name is eligible only with a **full** trailing window (sort runs 2015-01 → 2026-05, 137 months) |
| Execution / costs | one documented lag: signal through close of month `t` → hold month `t+1`. The costed timer charges 2 sides × one-way cost × NAV per monthly rebalance; the short book pays 50 bps/yr borrow |
| Statistics | Newey-West (HAC, 6-lag) *t* on the monthly spread; one-sample *t*; Welch *t* on the pooled low-vs-high books; a 1,000-permutation placebo; a 20-seed synthetic positive control |

**Survivorship — named on the Signal axis.** `UNIVERSE` is a **current-membership** list of
names that are liquid mega-caps *today*, so the magnitudes are an **upper bound**. This bites
hardest on the **short** leg: the high-TK lottery names that actually blew up and delisted are
absent, so the realised short-book returns — and the tradable magnitude — are an upper bound.

## The headline — long-low-TK / short-high-TK spread

Monthly equal-weight bottom-30% (low TK) minus top-30% (high TK) spread (n = **137** months,
2015-01 → 2026-05, median 50 names/month):

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| **spread (long low-TK − short high-TK)** | **+138.70 bps/month** |
| Newey-West(6) *t* | **+3.15** |
| one-sample *t* | +2.87 |
| low-TK book / high-TK book | +232.81 bps / +94.11 bps (Welch *t* = +2.05) |
| gross spread Sharpe (no cost, ann.) | 0.85 |

The claimed edge **replicates, with the predicted sign.** Barberis-Mukherjee-Wang predict a
*positive* long-low/short-high spread (high-TK, lottery-like names under-earn); on this
mega-cap universe the spread is **significantly positive** (+138.70 bps/month, NW *t* = +3.15):
the boring **low-TK** names out-earned the lottery-like **high-TK** names over 2015–2026,
exactly as prospect theory predicts. The gap is entirely on the long leg (low-TK +232.81 vs
high-TK +94.11 bps/month).

## Placebo — is the relation a lucky alignment of the sort?

Keep the TK sort but read each month's forward returns from a **column-permuted** panel
(signal → outcome link broken), 1,000 permutations (20 seeds × 50):

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| observed spread | **+138.70 bps** |
| placebo mean (sd) | +0.166 bps (33.869) |
| position of observed | ≈ **+4.09σ into the right tail** (right-tail p = 0.000) |

The permutation null centres at zero; the observed +138.70 bps sits far in the **right** tail,
so the relation is real and not a lucky sort — the sign matches the literature's.

## Robustness — two eras (split 2020-01-01)

| era | spread | NW *t* |
|---|--:|--:|
| 2015-01 → 2020-01 (n=60) | +100.35 bps | **+2.00** |
| 2020-01 → 2026-05 (n=77) | +168.58 bps | **+2.48** |

The positive spread holds in both halves (the later, higher-dispersion era is stronger) — this
is not one era's artefact.

## The timer — can you get paid for it?

Charge 2 sides × one-way × NAV per monthly rebalance; short pays 50 bps/yr borrow.

| one-way cost | gross/mo | cost/reb | net/mo | *t* (net) | Sharpe (net) | ~ann. |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **1 bp** | +138.70 bps | 6.17 bps | **+132.53 bps** | +2.74 | 0.81 | +15.9%/yr |
| **5 bps** | +138.70 bps | 14.17 bps | **+124.53 bps** | +2.57 | 0.76 | +14.9%/yr |

The monthly-rebalanced spread is large relative to the friction, so the **net edge survives**
conservative costs (net *t* = +2.57 even at 5 bps one-way). It is therefore **not a Mirage** —
but the tradable magnitude rests on two fragile props: the **survivorship** upper bound (the
short leg's blown-up lottery names are absent), and a **50-name universe** that concentrates the
short into a handful of hard-to-borrow lottery mega-caps (TSLA/NVDA/AMD-type) whose realistic
borrow and squeeze risk exceeds the 50 bps/yr charged. **Fragile**, not a clean Investable.

## Synthetic positive control — the machinery is unbiased

Deterministic seeded panel with a persistent latent "gamble tilt" that shapes each name's
return skewness (a right-skewed tape → high TK value) and (with `edge>0`) depresses its forward
mean. No network.

| world | spread NW *t* |
|---|--:|
| null (`edge = 0`), **20 seeds** | mean **−0.11** (sd 1.01), **\|t\| ≥ 2 in 0/20 seeds** |
| planted (`edge = 0.0020`, seed 806) | **+2.82** (Welch *t* = +2.40) |

The detector recovers a *planted* Barberis-Mukherjee-Wang relation cleanly and never fires on
the null — so the positive real-tape result is a genuine signal, not a machinery bias.
*(A faithful-engine / power check only — never cited in support of the real-tape stamp.)*

## Verdict

- **Signal — REAL.** The Barberis-Mukherjee-Wang prospect-theory-value premium **replicates**
  on 50 liquid US mega-caps with the **predicted sign**: the long-low-TK / short-high-TK spread
  is **+138.70 bps/month** (NW *t* = **+3.15**), holds in both eras (*t* = +2.00 / +2.48), sits
  ≈**4.09σ into the right tail** of a 1,000-permutation placebo, and a 20-seed synthetic control
  recovers a planted relation cleanly (fires on **0/20** nulls). The boring low-TK names
  out-earned the lottery-like high-TK names, exactly as prospect theory predicts. *Survivorship:
  current-membership mega-caps — magnitudes are an upper bound.*
- **Tradability — FRAGILE.** The net edge **survives** conservative costs (**+124.53 bps/month**
  at 5 bps one-way, *t* = +2.57, ≈+14.9%/yr) — so this is not a Mirage — but the magnitude is a
  **survivorship upper bound** (the short leg's delisted lottery names are absent) and the 50-name
  universe concentrates the short into a few hard-to-borrow lottery mega-caps whose realistic
  borrow/squeeze cost exceeds the 50 bps/yr charged. Real signal, fragile paycheck.
